description: This file contains unit tests for the GrainLocatorResolver class in an Orleans-based project. It tests the resolution of different grain locators such as DHT, cached, and client locators, using dependency injection and mocking frameworks.

classes.name: GrainLocatorResolverTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the GrainLocatorResolver's ability to correctly resolve different types of grain locators based on configuration.

methods.name: GrainLocatorResolverTests
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the test environment, including dependency injection, mocking, and host configuration.

methods.name: ReturnsDhtGrainLocatorWhenUsingDhtDirectory
methods.description: Test method verifying that the resolver returns the DhtGrainLocator when the DHT directory is used.

methods.name: ReturnsCachedGrainLocatorWhenUsingCustomDirectory
methods.description: Test method verifying that the resolver returns the CachedGrainLocator when a custom directory is used.

methods.name: ReturnsClientGrainLocatorWhenUsingClient
methods.description: Test method verifying that the resolver returns the ClientGrainLocator when a client is used.
